offering_description.value: Manufactures and supplies HVAC, plumbing and electrical products for professional contractors, engineered building products for construction projects, and lubricants and sealants for industrial maintenance customers. It also distributes pipe, valves and fittings and provides regional installation and servicing for fire- and smoke-rated protection systems.

quotes.quote: For 185 years combined, RectorSeal, TRUaire and Shoemaker Manufacturing have manufactured and supplied thousands of products for commercial and residential applications, primarily for professional tradesmen who have used them for generations.

CSW provides value to our customers through a broad, yet complementary range of leading products that provide performance-optimizing solutions for diverse industrial and construction applications that enable enhanced customer service through scalability, operational efficiencies, and extensive distribution networks. The end markets we serve with our well-known brands include HVAC/R, general industrial, plumbing, construction, energy, mining, and rail. Our solutions have two essential commonalities: performance and reliability, earning us the enduring confidence of our customers in every industry we serve.
